In the classroom of OO Elementary School, Bobo, a gentle and shy little hedgehog, often had his cheeks pinched or his back suddenly hugged by his classmates. Although Bobo felt uncomfortable, he always endured it without making a sound for fear of upsetting his classmates. The teacher noticed Bobo's distress and gently said to him, "Bobo, your body is your most precious treasure! If you feel uncomfortable, you have the right to protect yourself!" The teacher taught him to straighten his chest, extend his palms forward, and say loudly and firmly, "Please stop! I don't like this!" At the end of class, when a classmate tried to pinch his cheek again, Bobo immediately stood at attention, extended his palms, and shouted "Stop!" The classmate was stunned for a moment, then quickly apologized and stepped back. Bobo realized that only by bravely saying no could others truly respect him!

「報告老師，我已經翻到第十八頁了，請問第三步是要交給誰？」: "Teacher, I've turned to page eighteen. Who should I give the third step to?"
「報告老師，轉角有低年級弟弟跌倒了，小畯正在陪他！」: "Teacher, a younger boy fell down around the corner, and Jun is with him!"
「報告老師，黑板中間反光我看不太清楚字，我想要換個角度看。」: "Teacher, the reflection in the middle of the blackboard makes it hard for me to see the words clearly. I'd like to try looking at it from a different angle."
「報告阿姨，是一輛黑色的轎車，車窗貼黑膜，往大馬路逃跑了！」: "Auntie, it's a black sedan with tinted windows, it's running off onto the main road!"
「塗出格子外面沒關係，我把它塗成大海浪，變成超級大瀑布！」: "It's okay if I paint outside the grid; I'll paint it like ocean waves, like a giant waterfall!"
「壞秘密零容忍，勇敢說出不怕黑！信任大人在身邊，校園安全百分百！」: "Zero tolerance for bad secrets, speak out bravely and fearlessly! Trust that adults are by your side, and campus safety is 100% guaranteed!"
「多給小樹喝水、不隨便摘花拔葉，我們讓OO校園變成美麗大森林！」: "By watering the saplings and refraining from picking flowers and leaves, we'll transform the OO campus into a beautiful forest!"
「大家保持一個手臂的距離，像小火車一樣一節跟一節！」: "Everyone keep an arm's length apart, like a little train, one carriage after another!"
「大家保持隊形不要分散，注意右邊慢車，全員平安抵達人行道！」: "Everyone, keep in formation and don't break apart. Watch out for the slower vehicles on your right. Everyone, please reach the pedestrian crossing safely!"
「大家先別吵，骰子是五點，一、二、三、四、五，棋子應該停在這裡！」: "Everyone, please calm down! The dice show a five: one, two, three, four, five. The piece should stop here!"
「大家在跑道兩旁加油，把路留給小和，我們是永不放棄的第一名！」: "Everyone cheer on from both sides of the track, leave the way for He, we are the number one team that never gives up!"
「大家安靜！小和每天都有練習，笑別人很不禮貌！」: "Quiet down, everyone! He practices every day; it's very impolite to laugh at others!"
「大家快蹲下！現在是避難時間，我們要保持安靜、保護頭部！」: "Everyone, quickly crouch down! This is evacuation time. We need to remain quiet and protect our heads!"
「大家放輕鬆，還有充裕的時間，深呼吸，慢慢寫！」: "Relax, everyone. There's plenty of time. Take a deep breath and write slowly!"
「大家早安！寒假結束了，我的大腦已經重新開機，準備好上課了！」: Good morning everyone! Winter break is over, and my brain has been rebooted and is ready for class!
「大家早安！我是小宇，新學期請大家多多指教！」: Good morning everyone! I'm Yu, nice to meet you all in the new semester!
「大家早！我跟著大家一起朗讀課文，聲音清楚又宏亮！」: "Good morning, everyone! I'll read the text aloud with you all, my voice clear and loud!"
「大家桌子排整齊，椅子收進去，走廊保持通暢安全！」: "Everyone, please arrange the tables neatly, put the chairs away, and keep the hallways clear and safe!"
「大家沒有罵我還幫我加油，我一定要用盡全力跑完每一公尺！」: "No one cursed at me; instead, they cheered me on. I'm determined to run every meter with all my might!"
「大家說話都有看著彼此微笑，我們說話的氣氛好溫暖！」: "Everyone was smiling at each other while we were talking; the atmosphere was so warm!"
「大家都不生氣了，一起畫畫最開心了！我幫暴龍畫一頂閃閃發光的頭盔！」: "Everyone's calmed down now, and drawing together is the most fun! I'll draw a sparkly helmet for the Tyrannosaurus Rex!"
「大聲拒絕、快快離開、找大人幫忙！身體自主權，我們自己做主！」: "Say no loudly, leave quickly, and find an adult for help! We have the right to make our own decisions about our bodies!"
「太厲害了！從小宇說出四分到深呼吸降回三分，只用了三十秒！」: "That's amazing! From Yu saying 40% to taking a deep breath and lowering it back to 30%, it only took 30 seconds!"
「太棒了！大家都有做到先舉手、等點名、再發言，課堂秩序一百分！」: "Great job! Everyone raised their hands first, waited to be called on, and then spoke. Perfect classroom order!"
「奶奶您好！這個博愛座給您坐，請小心慢慢坐下來！」: "Hello, Grandma! This is a priority seat for you. Please sit down carefully!"
「好吧！雖然不是全部畫侏羅紀，但戴太空帽的暴龍真的很帥，我同意！」: "Okay! Although it's not all Jurassic period paintings, the Tyrannosaurus Rex wearing a space helmet looks really cool, I agree!"
「好啊！歡迎加入！我們剛好缺一個後衛，你來防守這邊！」: "Great! Welcome! We're short a defender, you can defend this side!"
「好好說話力量大！用『我覺得』代替吵架，我們又能一起快樂畫畫了！」: "Speaking kindly has great power! By replacing arguments with 'I think,' we can enjoy drawing together again!"
「好球我接到了！我最喜歡獵豹，因為獵豹跑得跟我一樣快！」: "Good shot! I caught it! I love cheetahs the most because they run as fast as me!"
「好險好險！付完錢拿到發票才能拆封，我是遵守超商禮貌的好顧客！」: "Thank goodness! I can only open the package after paying and receiving the invoice. I'm a good customer who follows the convenience store's etiquette!"
「好險小和拉住我！差點衝動犯大錯！安全第一，我只去有救生員的乾淨泳池！」: "Thank goodness He grabbed me! I almost made a big mistake! Safety first, I only go to clean pools with lifeguards!"
「好險！差點踩到人了！我現在是國慶小衛兵，走路專心不推擠！」: "That was close! I almost stepped on someone! I'm a National Day little guard now, walking carefully and not pushing!"
「好險！我差點又大叫插嘴了！我要練習耐心等候，遵守課堂舉手規則！」: "That was close! I almost yelled and interrupted again! I need to practice being patient and following the rules for raising my hand in class!"
「好！雖然還想玩，但我上課要專心，下課再繼續蓋！」: "Okay! I still want to play, but I need to concentrate in class. I'll continue building after class!"
「媽媽今天您坐著休息！今天的晚飯碗筷和客廳地板全部交給我包辦！」: "Mom, you can sit and rest today! I'll take care of all the dishes for dinner and cleaning the living room floor!"
「媽媽您辛苦了！這是我親手做的康乃馨，祝您母親節快樂，我永遠愛您！」: "Mom, you've worked so hard! These are carnations I made myself. Happy Mother's Day! I love you forever!"
「字超出格子沒關係，我擦掉慢慢寫，不發脾氣把本子弄髒！」: "It's okay if the words go beyond the lines, I'll erase them and write slowly, I won't get angry and ruin the notebook!"
「安全帶扣好了！戴上耳罩看外面的大樹像在看電影，真好玩！」: "Seatbelt buckled! Wearing the earmuffs and looking at the big trees outside is like watching a movie, it's so much fun!"
「對不起小嘉！我以後絕對不碰你的書包拉鍊，我會當個守信用的好朋友！」: "I'm sorry, Jia! I promise I'll never touch your backpack zipper again. I'll be a good friend who keeps her word!"
「對不起小宇！我剛才是想跟你玩，我不知道你不喜歡，我以後不會了！」: "I'm sorry, Yu! I just wanted to play with you. I didn't know you didn't like it. I won't do it again!"
「對不起小宇！我跑太快撞到了，我保證放學請媽媽買一把全新的還你！」: "I'm so sorry, Yu! I was running too fast and bumped into you. I promise I'll ask my mom to buy you a brand new one after school!"
「對不起！我不知道你害怕！我把面具摘下來了，這顆草莓糖送給你！」: "I'm sorry! I didn't know you were scared! I've taken off my mask, and this strawberry candy is for you!"
「對不起！我剛才靠太近了！我退後一步，這樣我們都有舒服的安全氣囊！」: "Sorry! I was too close! I'll take a step back so we can both comfortably use the airbags!"
「對不起！是我跑太急撞倒你的積木！我幫你一起把積木撿起來重蓋！」: "I'm sorry! I was running too fast and knocked over your blocks! Let me help you pick them up and rebuild!"
「對！我也還在學！生氣不能把東西做好，慢慢來才能組出最漂亮的飛機！」: "Yes! I'm still learning too! Getting angry won't get you anywhere good; you have to take it slow to assemble the most beautiful airplane!"
「小和不要怕，健康中心就在前面，護理師阿姨有神奇涼涼藥膏！」: "Don't be afraid, He! The health center is just ahead, and the nurse has some amazing cooling ointment!"
「小和不要撕！撕掉還要重寫更累！拿膠帶貼起來就跟新的一樣了！」: "He, don't tear it! Tearing it up means you'll have to rewrite it, which is even more tiring! Just tap it back on, and it'll look brand new!"
「小和你看，是翻到這頁畫豆芽菜！我幫你把本子打開！」: "He, look, turn to this page and draw bean sprouts! Let me open the notebook for you!"
「小和加油，我看著課本上的字，隨時可以幫你一起念！」: "Keep it up, He! I'm looking at the words in your textbook, I can help you read them anytime!"
「小和快來！我們缺一個搖繩子的超級大隊長，你搖得最好最穩了！」: "He, come quick! We need a super captain to crank the rope, and you crank it the best and most steadily!"
「小和恭喜你贏了！這盤棋下得真刺激，下次換我挑戰你，我一定會更努力！」: "Congratulations on your win, He! That was a really exciting game. Next time, it'll be my turn to challenge you, and I'll definitely try my best!"
「小和拿好這個乾淨塑膠袋，頭靠在椅背上閉上眼睛，我在旁邊陪你！」: "He, take this clean plastic bag, lean your head back in your chair, close your eyes, I'll stay here with you!"
「小和衝啊！看著前方終點線，每一位跑完的人都是大英雄！」: "Go, Kazuha! Look at the finish line ahead! Everyone who finishes is a hero!"
「小和謝謝你！有你幫我們搖繩子，我們才能跳到三十下新紀錄！」: "He, thank you so much! Because of you helping us swing the rope, we were able to set a new record of thirty jumps!"
「小和，你剪短頭髮了！這樣夏天上體育課一定很涼快！」: "He, you cut your hair short! It will definitely keep you cool during PE class in the summer!"
「小嘉不要慌，筆尖泡一下溫水，說不定裡面的墨水還能救回來！」: "Jia, don't panic. Soak the pen nib in warm water; maybe the ink can still be salvaged!"
「小嘉別哭了，書包拉鍊拉緊了，你的小祕密都很安全喔！」: "Jia, don't cry. Your backpack zipper is tight, your little secrets are safe!"
「小嘉別急，我力氣大，我來幫忙把窗簾拉整齊，這樣就不刺眼了！」: "Jia, don't worry, I'm strong. I'll help you pull the curtains straight so they won't be too bright!"
「小嘉我在聽！五隻小鴨在水裡游泳，然後呢？」: "Jia, I'm listening! Five little ducks are swimming in the water, and then what?"
「小嘉每天早上都會笑瞇瞇跟我說早安，你的笑容像太陽一樣溫暖！」: "Jia greets me with a smile every morning, your smile is as warm as the sun!"
「小嘉，你剛才笑著說月球全壘打，請問你是在跟我開玩笑，還是在笑我？」: "Jia, you just laughed and said 'a home run on the moon.' Were you joking with me, or were you laughing at me?"
「小嘉，我的大紅色蠟筆借你畫！你慢慢畫，不要著急！」: "Jia, you can borrow my bright red crayon! Take your time, don't rush!"
「小宇不要害怕，我們在一起，演練三分鐘就結束了喔！」: "Yu, don't be afraid, we're all together. The drill will be over in three minutes!"
「小宇你先拿！這塊最大的蛋黃酥留給你，我拿旁邊的綠豆椪！」: "Yu, you go first! This biggest egg yolk pastry is for you, I'll take the mung bean cake next to it!"
「小宇你看著我講話，我覺得好舒服，我知道你在聽！」: "Yu, it feels so good to hear you talking to me. I know you're listening!"
「小宇你看，這個字右邊是力氣的力，我們一起寫一次就永遠記住了！」: "Yu, look, the right side of this character is the 'strength' of 'power.' Let's write it together once and you'll remember it forever!"
「小宇你看，這是今天中午擦黑板的加分，下次我們一起來報名打掃！」: "Yu, look, this is extra points for wiping the blackboard at noon today. Let's all sign up to clean it together next time!"
「小宇你需要黃色三角形嗎？我幫你找好了，推進器裝上這個最堅固！」: "Yu, do you need a yellow triangle? I've found one for you; it's the most sturdy one for the thrusters!"
「小宇先握握指壓球，跟我一起吸氣、吐氣，我們慢慢把溫度降下來！」: "Yu, first hold the acupressure ball, then inhale and exhale with me, and we'll slowly lower the temperature!"
「小宇別哭，我先幫你用膠帶固定好，暴龍圖案還看得很清楚喔！」: "Don't cry, Yu. Let me secure it with tape. The Tyrannosaurus Rex pattern is still clearly visible!"
「小宇別怕，我們都在這裡！這不是你的錯，大人會公正保護我們的！」: "Yu, don't be afraid, we're all here! This isn't your fault, the adults will protect us fairly!"
「小宇別急，我在外面陪你！等合作社人變少了我們再去買！」: "Yu, don't worry, I'll stay outside with you! We'll go buy it when there are fewer people at the cooperative!"
「小宇對不起！弄翻你的水彩是我的粗心，我下次一定會放慢動作，請你原諒我！」: "Yu, I'm so sorry! It was my carelessness that I spilled your watercolors. I'll definitely be more careful next time. Please forgive me!"
「小宇對不起！我講話太誇張讓你誤會了，我真的覺得你力氣很大很帥！」: "Yu, I'm sorry! I exaggerated and made you misunderstand. I really think you're very strong and handsome!"
「小宇對不起，我聽懂你的感受了！我保證不再搖晃桌子，我幫你按住畫紙！」: "Yu, I'm sorry, I understand how you feel! I promise I won't shake the table anymore, I'll hold the drawing paper down for you!"
「小宇我幫你扶著紙，你照著黑色的虛線慢慢剪，慢慢來不要急！」: "Yu, let me hold the paper for you. Cut slowly along the black dotted lines, take your time, don't rush!"
「小宇放輕鬆！小嘉是在稱讚你力氣大啦，我們排球隊需要你的強大發球！」: "Relax, Yu! Jia is just praising your strength. Our volleyball team needs your powerful serve!"
「小宇早安！一個月沒見，你長高了耶！今天下課我們再來比躲避球！」: "Good morning, Yu! You've grown taller in a month! Let's play dodgeball again after class today!"
「小宇歡迎來中間！我有恐龍貼紙分你一張，我們一起把功課寫完！」: "Yu, welcome to the center! I have a dinosaur sticker for you, let's finish our homework together!"
「小宇沒事沒事，大家都在同一隊，我們一起把球接好！」: "Yu, it's okay, it's okay. We're all on the same team, let's catch the ball together!"
「小宇謝謝你原諒我！你真好，我以後向你借東西一定會加倍小心！」: "Yu, thank you for forgiving me! You're so kind. I'll be much more careful when I borrow things from you in the future!"
「小宇謝謝你願意妥協！等畫完太空基地，下一次主題一定全部聽你的！」: "Yu, thank you for compromising! After we finish drawing the space base, I'll definitely follow your lead for the next theme!"
「小弟弟別哭，水壺蓋子沒破，我幫你拿著！小畯正在扶你！」: "Don't cry, little brother, the kettle lid isn't broken. I'll hold it for you! Jun is helping you!"
「小弟弟對不起，是大哥哥衝太快撞到你！我帶你去健康中心擦藥，慢慢走不要怕！」: "Little brother, I'm so sorry! I was running too fast and bumped into you! I'll take you to the health center to get some medicine applied. Walk slowly and don't be afraid!"
「小明我回來了！我已經拿出甲本翻到第十頁了，我準備好一起寫了！」: "Xiaoming, I'm back! I've taken out my copy of the textbook and turned to page ten. I'm ready to start writing!"
「小明，筆沒蓋好乾掉了我很心疼，請你先借我你的紅筆，下週買一支還我好嗎？」: "Xiaoming, my pen dried out because the cap wasn't on properly. I'm really upset. Could you lend me your red pen for now? I'll buy you a new one next week, okay?"
「小畯不要怕，我們大家都在這裡支持你，我們一起去找老師！」: "Jun, don't be afraid. We're all here to support you. Let's go find your teacher together!"
「小畯不要怕，擦藥涼涼的，一下子就不痛了，我在這裡陪你！」: "Don't be afraid, Jun. The medicine will feel cool and the pain will subside quickly. I'll stay here with you!"
「小畯你的聲音變溫柔了，我們這樣討論剛好聽得見！」: "Jun, your voice has become gentler; it's just the right size for us to hear each other during our discussion!"
「小畯你看！我現在看著你的眉心，我有專心聽你說話喔！」: "Little Jun, look! I'm looking at your forehead right now, I'm listening attentively to what you're saying!"
「小畯你看！這個保溫水壺冬天裝熱水超溫暖，而且草莓圖案好可愛喔！」: "Little Jun, look! This thermos is so warm and cozy when filled with hot water in winter, and the strawberry pattern is so cute!"
「小畯你真體貼！你一聽我說不要就馬上停下來，跟你做朋友好有安全感！」: "Jun, you're so considerate! You stopped right away as soon as I said no. I feel so safe being your friend!"
「小畯做得好，慢慢放鬆肩膀，烏龜殼保護你，你沒有動手打人超厲害！」: "Good job, Jun! Slowly relax your shoulders. The turtle shell protects you. You're amazing for not hitting anyone!"
「小畯去打球很開心，我也能在圖書館享受恐龍時光，我們放學還是好朋友！」: "Jun had a great time playing ball, and I enjoyed my dinosaur-themed time at the library. We're still good friends after school!"
「小畯快後退！絕對不准上陌生人的車！我們立刻跑去全家超商找店員阿姨！」: "Jun, back off! Absolutely no getting into a stranger's car! Let's run to FamilyMart right now and find the clerk!"
「小畯擦藥好勇敢，沒有哭哭！等一下擦好藥我們慢慢走回教室！」: "Little Jun was so brave to have the medicine applied; he didn't cry! After we finish applying the medicine, we'll slowly walk back to the classroom!"
「小畯早安，以後我們坐在一起，請你多多指教！」: "Good morning, Jun. We'll be sitting together from now on; please take good care of me!"
「小畯笑著說謝謝的樣子好有紳士風度！交換禮物最棒的是大家聚在一起的心意！」: "Jun's smile as he said thank you was so gentlemanly! The best part about exchanging gifts is the sentiment of everyone coming together!"
「小畯請退後一步！我們保持一隻手臂的安全距離，這樣我才覺得舒服！」: "Jun, please step back! Let's keep an arm's length distance; that's more comfortable for me!"
「小畯謝謝你！你前面買的地點都好厲害，我們大家一起玩最開心了！」: "Jun, thank you! The locations you bought earlier were amazing; we had so much fun playing together!"
「小畯，我看見你今天排隊時主動幫大家拿課本，你真的好熱心又大方！」: "Jun, I saw you helping everyone carry their textbooks while we were queuing today. You're so kind and generous!"
「小畯，我覺得很著急，因為這張圖畫快交了，我希望你不要搖桌子！」: "Jun, I'm really anxious because this drawing is due soon, and I hope you won't shake the table!"
「小組長我來幫忙發練習單！大家一人一張，我們這組準備好囉！」: "Group leader, I'll help distribute the practice sheets! One for everyone, our group is ready!"
「小綠人亮了！頭向左看、向右看，轉彎車輛都停住了，我們可以安全走了！」: "The little green man is lit up! He's looking left and right, and the cars turning have all stopped. We can go safely now!"
「少用塑膠、珍惜水電！舉手之勞做環保，我們是地球最棒的小守護者！」: "Use less plastic, cherish water and electricity! Doing something small to protect the environment makes us the best little guardians of our planet!"
「展翅高飛不害怕，OO四小英雄友誼永不散！大家暑假快樂、新年級加油！」: "Soar high without fear, the friendship of the four little heroes of OO will never fade! Happy summer vacation everyone, and best of luck to the new grade!"

Api's face flushed red to his ears, and he shyly buried his face in the jacket's hood, shrinking into a ball, too embarrassed to look at anyone. Teacher Owl smiled and handed Api a "praise magnifying glass" with gold trim: "Api, when others praise us, it's like giving us a sparkling gem. We don't need to hide; just stand tall, look them in the eyes, smile, and say, 'Thank you, I like this jacket too,' and that's the perfect gift!" Api pulled down the hood, looked at Jia, and smiled, saying, "Thank you, Jia, this is a gift from my dad! I also think your red bow tie is so cute today!" 特教學童因動作奇特或說話結巴，常被頑皮同儕私下取笑為『怪胎』、『機器人』或『大胖: Special needs students are often teased by their peers behind their backs for their unusual movements or stuttering, being called "freaks," "robots," or "fat boys." The goal is to teach these students to activate their "verbal defense" by giving them a firm look and saying, "That's not my name, please call me by my real name!" and to proactively report such remarks to their teachers.
特教學童在家中常因固著於自己想看的卡通或遊戲，與弟弟妹妹激烈搶奪遙控器或平板電腦: Special education students often get so fixated on the cartoons or games they want to watch that they fight fiercely with their younger siblings over remote controls or tablets, sometimes even scratching or biting each other, causing family conflicts. Guiding students to use physical timers and turn-taking agreements can help them learn to share generously.
特教學童在家中常過度依賴家長代勞，脫下的臭襪子亂丟在客廳、玩完的積木撒滿走廊，家: Special needs children often rely excessively on their parents for chores at home. Smelly socks are left scattered in the living room, and building blocks are strewn all over the hallway, leaving parents exhausted and experiencing parental burnout. Teaching them the "clothes-folding mantra: hug to the left, hug to the right, bow upwards" helps them develop self-care skills and give back to their families.
特教學童在成長過程中常因走路姿勢、戴厚重眼鏡或反應慢，承受無數異樣眼光而深陷自我: Special needs children often suffer from self-loathing and low self-esteem due to their gait, wearing thick glasses, or slow reaction time, enduring countless stares and judgments. Guiding children to stand in front of a large mirror, identify and loudly proclaim three shining qualities within themselves, helps them embrace their unique selves.
特教學童在抽離式特教班習慣了一對四的小班保護，鐘聲響起回到三十人的普通班時，常因: Special education children, accustomed to the protection of small classes of one to four in disengagement special education classes, often feel lost and stand blankly at the door when the bell rings to return to a regular class of thirty students. This is because the classroom is noisy, they cannot find their seats, or they have missed the progress. We teach them the transition method of "looking at the blackboard homework before entering the classroom, smiling and nodding to the neighbor when walking to their seats".
特教學童在玩大富翁、快手疊杯或卡牌遊戲時，對規則有極高固著與正義感，一旦發現同儕: Special education students exhibit a strong fixation on rules and a strong sense of justice when playing Monopoly, stacking cups, or card games. If they discover that a peer has taken an extra step or an extra card, they immediately assume "he's cheating" and slam their fist on the table to overturn the outcome. They are taught to "pause with their hands forming a 'T' shape with their chest, take out the instruction manual, and check it calmly."
特教學童常因單純、對陌生人缺乏警覺，或容易被糖果、寶可夢卡、可愛小狗吸引，遇到陌: Special education children are often naive and lack vigilance towards strangers, or are easily attracted by candy, Pokémon cards, or cute puppies. When a stranger in a car asks for directions and says, "Little one, get in the car and I'll buy you a drink," they readily get in. They should be taught the safety red lines: "Take three steps back, loudly refuse, and run to a convenience store for help."
特教學童常因大腦前庭與神經系統興奮、固著於漫畫或手機遊戲，到了深夜十一點仍拒絕就: Special education students often become so engrossed in comics or mobile games that their vestibular and nervous systems are overstimulated, leading them to refuse to go to bed until 11 p.m., creating a vicious cycle of difficulty waking up in the morning, irritability, and drowsiness in class. We teach them a 30-minute offline ritual before bedtime and deep relaxation breathing.
特教學童常因好奇心強烈或缺乏物權與隱私界線概念，隨意拉開同儕書包拉鍊、翻看聯絡簿: Special education children often unzip their peers' schoolbags and read the red letters in their contact books or diaries at will due to their strong curiosity or lack of concept of property rights and privacy boundaries, causing strong resentment among their peers. Guide school children to establish safe boundaries where "other people's personal belongings will never be touched".
特教學童常因認知直率，當眾說出『你的新髮型好醜』或『你的便當好臭』而引發人際災難: Special education children often suffer from interpersonal disasters due to their blunt cognition, saying "your new hair style is ugly" or "your lunch box smells so bad" in public. Guide school children to establish a "thinking filter", distinguish between "objective facts" and "hurtful comments", and learn to chew their brains three times before speaking.
